lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A cluster of approximately five high-luminance circular spots arranged in a staggered vertical formation immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, with a secondary horizontal pairing of spots further posterior along the lateral midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of spots, creating visible anchor nodes primarily in the mid-flank region above the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge extending across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a distinct shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple high-contrast, elongated silhouettes (remoras) are visible attached to the ventral-lateral area near the pectoral fin insertion.
